schemaValidation.note: Fresh connector validation before execution; exact saved all-active read query.

snapshotWindow.note: Sequential paginated read, not an atomic database snapshot. Root-owned correction activity on two products is separate. Every page timestamp is preserved; this snapshot still contains those43 checksum-failing values.

snapshotWindow.limit: Paged live read, not an atomic database snapshot; complete identifier and parent comparison found no unexpected drift.

method.classification: ASCII digits only, lengths 8/12/13/14; GS1 mod-10 sum over full identifier, rightmost weights 1 then 3. Null/blank counted EMPTY. Checksum passing does not verify GS1 or manufacturer assignment.
method.independentCrossCheck: Body excludes check digit; rightmost body weights 3 then 1; computed digit compared with last digit. Both algorithms run over all before and after rows.
method.clearComparison: Only exact null or empty string accepted for executed values. Every unexecuted value compared using exact raw equality.

duplicateBarcodes.assessment: Remaining populated duplicate values retained unchanged; checksum passing is not manufacturer verification or proof of correct product assignment.

limitations: 125 populated identifiers pass checksum but manufacturer/GS1 assignment remains unverified.
Remaining duplicate barcode assignments need provenance review; values were preserved because checksum alone cannot establish which assignment is correct.
